description: What the changeable message signs over the national freeways, provincial highways or a city’s roads show right now: travel times to the next interchanges, congestion, incidents and roadworks warnings. Example: network "freeway", keyword "汐止", direction "S".

direction.description: Only devices facing traffic heading this way (S also matches SE and SW).

keyword.description: Only results whose road or place contains this, e.g. "國道1號", "林口", "建國高架".

limit.description: Maximum number of signs to return (default 15).

network.description: Road network: "freeway" (國道, national freeways), "highway" (省道, provincial highways) or a city (Taipei, Taoyuan, Taichung, 臺北市, ...).

name: traffic_signs
title: Road message signs
